title: Loopy Reflections
content: Detail of Sommarnoje by Anders ZornIn his 1903 book "Light and Water," Montagu Pollock describes reflections that create "a chain of loops or a series of disconnected rings. Such rings are amongst the commonest features of gently moving water in the foreground of a picture. The reflexions of a boom or bowsprit, or of any conspicuous horizontal line, often assume this form."-----Light and Waterby Montagu Pollock on AmazonDigital copy on Archive.org
